notes.title: SAND LAND – Dev Diaries Episode 4: Forest Land
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome back to the [b]SAND BOX[/b]![/h2]

[previewyoutube=Om95WVzMMYA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]In this [b]final installment of the SAND LAND Dev Diary[/b] series, we're talking all about [b]FOREST LAND[/b], a [i]brand new region full of lush vegetation[/i], [i]new monsters and missions[/i], and a [b]brand new story[/b]! [/h3]

[h2][b]Get ready for the ride of a limetime! Pre-order now![/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1979440/SAND_LAND/?beta=0

notes.title: Check out the new characters!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Ann[/b][/h2]
[h3]A [b]self-proclaimed ace mechanic[/b] who travels all over SAND LAND [b]on a large motorcycle[/b]. She meets [b]Beelzebub and his friends[/b] by chance and [b]joins them on their journey[/b]. [b]Ann's origins are unknown[/b] and it appears the key to solving the mystery seems to [i]lie in a necklace that she says is more important than life[/i].[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225179/3a70bbf21721ba55bf25a2dc8aca11740d1453e8.png[/img]
[h2][b]Muniel[/b][/h2]
[h3]An [b]angel that came from Celestial World[/b]. He [b]so-called himself as hero in FOREST LAND[/b]. He has [i]"something" with fiend and demons[/i].[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225179/02ec64500d719a5a596af195f2a939e8c34ecc19.png[/img]
[h2][b]Supreme Commander Bred[/b][/h2]
[h3]The [b]Supreme Commander of Forest Land Royal Army[/b]. With absolute military power behind him, he [i]controls all power in FOREST LAND[/i].[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225179/44ccaf591bef58bd982ec0f9c5de36bda51c2c3e.png[/img]
[h2][b]Are you ready to save the world? Pre-order now and join the thirstiest of adventures![/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1979440/SAND_LAND/

notes.title: Go beyond SAND LAND and continue into FOREST LAND!
notes.content:
[h2]This [b]new world and characters[/b] have been imagined [b]by creator Akira Toriyama specifically for the video game and animated series[/b], expanding the [i]world of SAND LAND with new adventures[/i].[/h2]

[previewyoutube=R-QLnmBpw-k;full][/previewyoutube]
Beyond [b]the dunes and the scorching desert sun[/b], lies a [b]lush and green nation called FOREST LAND[/b]. Although peaceful at first glance, this place is [b]governed by a ferocious army[/b] opposing SAND LAND. Leading this force is [b]Muniel, fearsome despite his childlike features[/b], he is determined to save his land by [b]getting his hands on a supply of Aquanium[/b], a powerful but dangerous resource, and [b]he will not back down without a fight[/b].

[h3]More information [url=https://bnent.eu/SandLand_ForestLand][b]HERE[/b][/url]:[/h3]
[url=https://bnent.eu/SandLand_ForestLand][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225179/fa2d92565c7b2ae418eb6cf8f092dc454f331614.png[/img][/url]

[h2][b]Keep an eye out to what's beyond the SAND LAND... And try the demo now![/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1979440/SAND_LAND/

notes.title: Pre-orders open - dive into the desert!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Get ready for the ride of a limetime![/b][/h2]

[h3]Customize [b]vehicles[/b], build up your [b]camp[/b], infiltrate [b]enemy bases[/b] and fight off [b]bosses[/b] to [b][i]bring water back to the land[/i][/b].[/h3]

[previewyoutube=pF8OHr5KJss;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Joining [b]Beelzebub, the Fiend Prince[/b], his [b]chaperone Thief[/b] and [b]Sheriff Rao[/b], prepare to [b]explore the vast desert and take on the Royal Army[/b] in [i]various customisable vehicles[/i]. This [b]unlikely team uniting humans and demons[/b] sets out on [b]an adventure in search for the Legendary Spring[/b] capable of [b]ending the terrible drought that has taken over the world[/b]. Together, they will [b]travel beyond Sand Land to uncharted territories[/b].[/h3]

[h3]Enjoy the [b]Deluxe Edition with exclusive digital content[/b] - [i]weapons[/i], [i]stickers[/i] and [i]furniture[/i] just for you![/h3]

notes.title: Victory on wheels... or paws? Vehicles will never stop surprising you!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Ride Hopper[/b][/h2]
[h3]A [b]walker mech with high jumping power[/b] similar to the Jump-Bot that can be [b]equipped with even more powerful weapons[/b]. Take advantage of the [b]Ride Hopper's high attack power[/b] but be warned, the [i]weapons do have some quirks[/i].[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225179/41fd33ffa4d8b444641c58b1c4528a73dc1dd4cb.png[/img]
[h2][b]Tamed raptor[/b][/h2]
[h3]A [b]wild raptor trained to be a mount[/b]. You can explore the desert safely on its back knowing [b]other monsters won't attack you mid-ride[/b]. But [i]be careful[/i], because if your [b]raptor friend gets too damaged, it'll run off[/b]![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44225179/56651ae60cdf4f8688e477f16201c3bb6e6c18c9.png[/img]
